# Volatility Farm

> Independent short-term research on stocks in the days after they report earnings - what changed, what the market got right or wrong, and the risks over the next 10-30 days.

Volatility Farm publishes one research report per company shortly after its earnings release, plus site-wide sections tracking an earnings calendar, cross-asset market regimes, and the realised performance of the ideas published here. Reports are informational research, not investment advice.

## Site sections

- [Calendar](https://volatilityfarm.com/#calendar): Upcoming and recent earnings dates for tracked tickers, with expected and realised price-impact statistics around the print.
- [Market Regimes](https://volatilityfarm.com/#regimes): Persistency (mean-reverting vs trending) and volatility (calm vs volatile) regime scatter plots for SP500, inverse volatility, gold, and short/intermediate/long-term bond proxies, traced over the last 30 days.
- [Performance](https://volatilityfarm.com/#performance): Realised performance of the portfolio implied by the published reports, benchmarked against SPX and VTI, with summary metrics (beta, alpha, Sharpe, Calmar, max drawdown, average position duration).
- [Reports archive](https://volatilityfarm.com/#reports): Full chronological list of every published company report.
- [Method](https://volatilityfarm.com/#method): How reports are built - scope-before-data, sourced tables, no investment advice, in-house analytics.
- [About](https://volatilityfarm.com/#about): Who publishes this, coverage, community, and contact.

## Reports

One short-term research report per company, published within a few days of its earnings release. Each covers the print itself, the market reaction, and the risks over the following 10-30 days.

- [PepsiCo, Inc. - 8 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/pepsico-inc-2026-10-08.htm): Q3 2026 beat on revenue and EPS, but full-year core EPS growth guidance was cut to +1–2% from at least +4%, and the stock closed at a 52-week low of $123.73 after nine target cuts in two weeks. The next 10–30 days hinge on whether a cheap valuation holds against a regime backdrop that has rarely favoured PEP, with Coca-Cola and the late-October snack prints as the deciding catalysts.
- [Neogen Corporation - 7 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/neogen-corporation-2026-10-07.htm): Neogen beat Q1 FY27 revenue by 9% and nudged FY27 guidance up, trading 11% higher after hours, but with 97% of daily variance company-specific and the stock at its lowest Persistency reading of the year, the next 10–30 days hinge on the Investor Day and the HYCOAT warning-letter response, not the market.
- [Penguin Solutions, Inc. - 7 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/penguin-solutions-2026-10-07.htm): Penguin beat on Q4 sales and raised FY27 guidance 40%, but the stock had already risen 24% in 30 sessions with operating cash flow negative for the year, so the next 10–30 days test whether post-print target raises confirm demand before the July pattern of a sharp reversal repeats.
- [NIKE, Inc. - 2 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/nike-inc-2026-10-02.htm): After the 1 October close Nike beat on EPS ($0.48 vs $0.43) but missed on revenue ($11.21B, -4%), guiding FY27 adjusted EPS to $1.15-1.35, about 22% below the $1.61 consensus. Shares fell 6.2% after hours to $32.96, a 13-year low, and the next 10-30 days hinge on whether consensus can reset lower into a stock at about 26x guided earnings, in the weakest regime backdrop of any name in this series.
- [Accenture plc - 2 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/accenture-plc-2026-10-02.htm): Accenture rose 15.8% on 1 October, its best day on record, after a Q4 beat and $100M+ bookings hit a quarterly record. But the FY27 guide implies only about 0.5-4% organic growth, and the next 10-30 days hold the gain only if analyst upgrades and the October IT-services prints show AI adding to demand rather than deflating it.
- [Jabil Inc. - 1 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/jabil-inc-2026-10-01.htm): Jabil beat on every line and guided FY27 above consensus, but the stock fell 10% on a lighter margin guide and crowded AI-linked positioning, with the next 10–30 days testing whether that drop was overdone.
- [Micron Technology, Inc. - 1 Oct 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/micron-technology-2026-10-01.htm): Micron cleared every bar at seven times run-rate earnings, but the risk for the month is the cycle debate, not the numbers, with the stock trading at about 7× annualised guidance.
- [Carnival Corporation Ltd. - 30 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/carnival-corporation-2026-09-30.htm): A beat-and-raise lifted shares 13.4% on record yields and deposits, but with fuel unhedged and a soft Q4 guide, the next 10–30 days hinge on whether crude falls back below $100.
- [Cintas Corporation - 25 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/cintas-corporation-2026-09-25.htm): A sixth straight beat-and-raise met an FTC antitrust review of the UniFirst deal, with no fixed timeline and the review itself the single event most likely to reprice the stock.
- [Worthington Enterprises, Inc. - 25 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/worthington-enterprises-2026-09-25.htm): A beat on every line met a spike that gave back most of its gain, with the stock in a $56–$62.5 range ahead of the 10 November Investor Day.
- [Brookfield Corporation - 19 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/brookfield-corporation-2026-09-19.htm): A 15% earnings beat met an 11% pullback tied to sector, not the company, with the next 10–30 days trading on the alternative-manager complex and a ten-year yield near 5%.
- [Trip.com Group Limited - 16 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/tripcom-group-2026-09-16.htm): A 50%-off-highs stock met a $763 million antitrust fine, with 94% of variance idiosyncratic and the next 10–30 days hinging on whether the regulatory chapter is closed.
- [NIO Inc - 2 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/nio-inc-2026-09-02.htm): A margin turnaround with 69% revenue growth met missed delivery guidance and a fresh 52-week low, with the September delivery report due around 1 October deciding the next move.
- [Science Applications International Corp - 1 Sep 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/saic-2026-09-01.htm): A beat and raised guide printed an all-time high before reversing to close up just 1.8%, with book-to-bill at 0.8 and no company catalyst until December.
- [Frontline plc - 28 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/frontline-plc-2026-08-28.htm): A record quarter and the largest payout in years lands the shares at a 52-week high, with the next 10–30 days hinging on spot tanker rates against a scheduled dividend drop.
- [J.M. Smucker Company - 26 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/jm-smucker-2026-08-26.htm): A blowout beat on coffee pricing and tariff refunds pushed shares to a 52-week high and past the average analyst target, leaving a 99.9% idiosyncratic digestion trade.
- [Tuya Inc - 25 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/tuya-inc-2026-08-25.htm): Record premium customers and 16% revenue growth against a near-nil enterprise value, with the earnings catalyst spent and direction now hostage to China-internet sentiment.
- [Walmart Inc - 24 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/walmart-inc-2026-08-24.htm): A beat-and-raise quarter met with a 9.2% single-session drop on decelerating comps, leaving a 99.8% idiosyncratic name with no catalyst until November.
- [Alibaba Group Holding Ltd - 24 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/alibaba-group-holding-2026-08-24.htm): Cloud revenue accelerating 45% against a 75% profit drop, with a discounted $10.2bn Hong Kong share placement now the swing factor for the next month.
- [Lowe’s Companies Inc - 20 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/lowes-companies-inc-2026-08-20.htm): A light revenue miss and a guide cut to the bottom of every range, offset by a cheap multiple and an 87.9% idiosyncratic setup ahead of the September FOMC.
- [Home Depot Inc - 19 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/home-depot-inc-2026-08-19.htm): A best-in-class quarter and reaffirmed guidance met a flat tape, with no company catalyst until November and a premium multiple to defend.
- [Baidu Inc - 19 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/baidu-inc-2026-08-19.htm): First earnings miss in eight quarters and a close below book value, with AI-cloud growth real but no catalyst before November.
- [BHP Group Limited - 19 Aug 2026](https://volatilityfarm.com/reports/bhp-group-limited-2026-08-19.htm): Record FY2026 EBITDA and the largest dividend in four years, against an FY2027 copper guide cut 11.7% — the next 10–30 days trade as a copper-price instrument.
